papers.operator: Block-importance allocation; truncated factorization of all block projections; full hidden nonlinear width retained; MKD and rectified-flow recovery.
papers.comparison: Closest full-input factorized representation. The seed keeps exact group-mean W1, approximates only centered contrasts and pools post-Q2 before fullW2. This is a computational distinction, not proof of originality or quality.
papers.reproduction_boundary: Official repository at checked commit contains only README, not an executable reproduction. Parameter-budget results on other DiTs cannot be treated as measured Wan HiF4 FFN latency.

papers.operator: Keep the full first FFN projection and hidden nonlinearity; factor only the output projection, with training-time reparameterized branches.
papers.comparison: A known alternative to reducing nonlinear width. It retains all W1 rows and does not provide exact-mean/centered-input coupling; architecture-training classification results do not establish post-training Wan behavior.

papers.operator: Linear+sigmoid token router, learned layer/time keep ratios; selected tokens execute attention and MLP; others bypass the block. T2I LoRA rank32,20samplingsteps; training uses8A100s.
papers.code_check: Checked official pseudocode: gather top-k; restore remaining tokens; router gradients multiply selected MLP residual. Omitted PixArt initialization and undefined imported components prevent treating it as a complete runnable baseline.
papers.comparison: Conditional routing and trainable ratios are established prior art. A frozen-Wan FFN method needs a different demonstrated operator/value contribution and a matched adaptation, not a new router name.

papers.operator: Parameter-efficient self-distillation of differences between token-compression degrees; add/subtract LoRA products on attention query/value projections.
papers.code_check: Official models.py adds q_delta and v_delta while keeping key unchanged; an adapter across source/target compression degrees. This is not an existing approximation of a four-row pooled HiF4 FFN mean.
papers.comparison: Known precedent for compensating a merge/compression mismatch. Training and merged-weight quantization must be charged if adapted to frozen D-Q.

papers.operator: Known bias correction b_hat=b+(W-B)*mean_x removes the linear output-mean error introduced by a low-rank B; DALR also fits activation-aware rank-constrained regression.
papers.comparison: W*mu+B*(x-mu)+b equals B*x+b+(W-B)*mu. The new local-current-group construction is algebraically a group-conditioned bias correction, with real current mean-W1 cost, rather than a new general low-rank identity. Pooled four-row quantized FFN execution and conditional value still need testing.
papers.novelty_boundary: Do not claim exact-mean correction, centering or the first-order cancellation as a new general compression idea.
papers.retrieval_note: CVF PDF returned403; original arXivv2 PDF opened successfully; author derivation also checked.

Closed one/two point sampler changes the joint four-row nonlinear law. Newseed instead preserves four approximate joint preactivation/GELU/Q2 rows; still needs actual Wan accuracy and strongest fixed/dynamic controls.
